body:
Two new pure-Python research projects on training with digital clones of physical systems, plus a new "Digital twins & sim-to-real" theme on the homepage.

- `research/twin-transfer`: exact scalar-LQ sim-to-real regret with a stability cliff; validation blind spot (a twin can score zero log-gap on passive logs yet mistrain control); a twin is worth exactly σ²/(vδ²) real probe samples at any accuracy target.
- `research/randomized-twin`: domain randomization over the twin's input gain: cliff-limited width, quartic price when the twin was right, and uniform-average training is not minimax.

12 + 9 tests pass; `python site/build.py` prints ok. README bullets and `site/projects.json` updated.
